description: AGSC-09-14b: besides the seven tools, the tool server exposes every published item as an MCP resource of media type text/markdown, `graph.jsonld` as application/ld+json and `llms.txt` as text/plain, under the URIs memory://<bundle-id>/<slug>, memory://<bundle-id>/graph.jsonld and memory://<bundle-id>/llms.txt, listed in code-point order of the URI; and exactly one prompt, named answer-from-this-memory-with-citations, whose title and description are "answer from this memory with citations" and which takes exactly one required argument, question. A resource URI or a prompt name that does not exist is a JSON-RPC error, not the tool envelope of AGSC-09-13a. Derivation, by hand from the rule: the fixture is bundle.id minimal and publishes the three items of content/ (agent-patterns, handoff, supervisor), so the list holds five URIs; sorted by code point, graph.jsonld falls between agent-patterns and handoff and llms.txt between handoff and supervisor. The frames of input.frames are sent, in order, to the implementation's tool server for the fixture over standard input; each entry of expected.responses is compared with the response of the same id as a subset (a member the rule does not pin — a resource's name, title or text, an argument's description — is not compared; a list is compared element by element and must have the same length), and an expected `error` member means the response is a JSON-RPC error and carries no `result`.
